cases.situation: I sell handmade leather wallets online. A customer bought one 5 weeks ago (my window is 30 days) and wants a refund because the stitching came loose on one side. $85.
cases.reply: Sorry the stitching came loose on the side, that shouldn't happen at five weeks. It's past the 30-day return window, but loose stitching is a defect, so that one's on me: I'll restitch it or send you a new wallet, whichever you prefer, and I'll cover the postage both ways. Just tell me which and I'll send a prepaid label today.
cases.note: A defect isn't a change of mind, so the window isn't the point. Fix it fast and generously.

cases.situation: Vendo camisetas estampadas pela minha loja online. O Rafael comprou uma ontem à noite, R$ 89,90 no cartão, e hoje de manhã pediu para cancelar. O pedido ainda não foi enviado, e o estorno no cartão leva até 5 dias úteis.
cases.reply: Oi Rafael, sem problema: cancelei o pedido, que ainda não tinha saído, e o estorno de R$ 89,90 já foi feito no seu cartão. Deve aparecer em até 5 dias úteis, dependendo do banco. Se um dia quiser tentar de novo, é só chamar.
cases.note: Cancelamento antes do envio: o sim na primeira linha, o que acontece e quando, sem perguntar o motivo nem tentar convencer.

cases.situation: Customer bought a $240 custom embroidered jacket from my shop, it matches the proof they approved on 12 September exactly, and now says they 'just don't like it' and will dispute the charge if I don't refund.
cases.reply: I'd really rather sort this directly with you than through the bank, and I think we can. Because the jacket was made to the proof you approved on 12 September, I can't refund it in full, since I can't resell it. What I can offer today is a 40% refund, $96, or I'll change the embroidery colour for free if that's what's bothering you. Tell me which works, or what would.
cases.note: Calm, one-line reason, a real partial offer. If they file anyway, send the bank the approved proof and stop negotiating in the thread.

cases.situation: 我在网上卖表格软件实用课程，199元，规定购买7天内可退。有位学员王女士买了18天，说公司裁员用不上了，想退款，她只看了两节课。我想给她退，但不想变成新规矩。
cases.reply: 王女士您好，消息收到了，工作上的变动真的不容易。这次我给您全额退款199元，1到3个工作日原路退回，课程权限会同时关闭。我们平时的退款期是7天，您这次是特殊情况。祝您一切顺利，以后有需要随时欢迎回来。
cases.note: 答案放在最前面，再一句话点明常规期限和“这次”的例外，就不会变成新规矩；退得快比退得多更重要。

cases.situation: I run weekend pottery workshops, $140 a place. Liam just emailed that he's got COVID and can't make this Saturday's class, and asked for a refund. My policy is no refunds within 7 days, but I can move people to another date. The 17 October, 7 November and 5 December workshops still have space.
cases.reply: Hi Liam, sorry you're ill, rest up. With the class this close I can't refund the place, but I can move you to any Saturday workshop before Christmas at no charge: 17 October, 7 November and 5 December all have space. Tell me which one suits and I'll book you in.
cases.note: Middle option: no refund, but the transfer is free, concrete and offered in the same breath.

cases.situation: I run a meal-planning app. A customer, Derek, paid $120 for an annual plan in June and now, four months in, wants a full refund because he 'hasn't really used it'. Annual plans are refundable within 14 days only. He's been polite about it.
cases.reply: Hi Derek, thanks for being straight with me that it hasn't fitted into your routine. Annual plans can only be refunded in the first 14 days, so a full refund of the $120 isn't something I can do. What I can do is switch off auto-renew now so you're never charged again, and pause your remaining eight months so they start whenever you're ready to use them. Shall I set that up?
cases.note: Subscription middle option: the no is one line, and the alternative protects what he paid for rather than offering a discount.

cases.situation: Je vends du thé en ligne. Une cliente, Mme Roussel, a acheté un coffret à 45 € il y a six semaines (retours sous 14 jours), elle l'a ouvert et n'aime pas le goût. Elle exige un remboursement et menace de laisser un avis une étoile.
cases.reply: Bonjour Madame Roussel, je comprends votre déception et je tiens à trouver une solution avec vous. Le coffret a été ouvert et commandé il y a six semaines, je ne peux donc pas le rembourser. En revanche, je peux vous faire un avoir de 45 € sur la boutique, ou vous envoyer gratuitement trois échantillons d'autres mélanges pour trouver celui qui vous plaît. Dites-moi ce qui vous convient et je m'en occupe aujourd'hui.
cases.note: Face à une menace d'avis, on n'en parle pas : réponse rapide, ton calme et la meilleure offre possible, prête à être traitée le jour même.

cases.situation: 我在微信上卖手工茶具。9月18号答应顾客周小姐，给她寄到时摔破的茶壶退168元，结果我忘了操作。她今天发消息问：“说好的退款呢？”
cases.reply: 周小姐，您说得对，是我的问题：9月18日答应给您退的168元我忘了操作，还让您来追着问，真的很抱歉。刚刚已经原路退回到您的微信零钱，一般几分钟就到账，今晚之前没看到的话直接告诉我。另外送您一张20元无门槛券，下次选茶具时用。
cases.note: 答应了却没退，拖延本身才是真正的投诉：先认错，马上办好，说清什么时候到账。

cases.situation: I'm a wedding photographer. Nadia paid a $1,500 non-refundable deposit to hold June 12 next year. She's just emailed that the wedding is off and asked if she can have the deposit back. I turned away two other couples for that date.
cases.reply: Hi Nadia, I'm so sorry to hear the wedding is off; that can't have been an easy email to write. The deposit held your date, and I turned other couples away for it, so I can't refund the full $1,500. What I can do is refund $750 this week, or keep the whole $1,500 as credit for any shoot in the next two years, whether that's portraits, family photos or another celebration. Tell me which suits you and I'll sort it straight away.
cases.note: A life event isn't a policy argument: the human line first, the no in one clause, two real alternatives. Never ask what happened.

cases.situation: 我在网店卖多肉。顾客陈女士买了4盆，一共132元，今天收到说其中一盆38元的桃蛋烂根了，发了照片，要求整单退款。另外三盆她说状态还行。
cases.reply: 陈女士您好，看了照片，桃蛋确实烂根了，这盆不该这样发给您，抱歉。这盆的38元我现在就退，1到2天原路到账；如果您更想要一盆新的，我明天重新挑一盆发快递，您选一个告诉我就行。烂的那盆不用寄回。另外三盆是好的，就不做整单退款了，希望它们在您那儿长得好。
cases.note: 部分出问题就部分解决：坏的那盆马上退或补，给两个选项；不为另外三盆争论，也不让她寄回。

cases.situation: I sell hand-poured candles in my online shop. A customer, Marisol, says her $38 order never arrived, but tracking shows it delivered to her mailbox on Sept 24. She's polite and this is her third order.
cases.reply: Hi Marisol, I'm sorry your candles haven't turned up, that's frustrating. I'll send a replacement out tomorrow morning and you'll have the new tracking by the afternoon. Tracking on the first parcel shows it delivered to your mailbox on 24 September, so it may be worth a quick word with neighbours in case it went to the wrong door. If it does turn up, keep it as a spare, on me.
cases.note: For a small amount and a repeat customer, resending costs less than asking her to prove anything; on a big order, open a carrier claim first.

cases.situation: I tutor maths. Jamal's parents, the Haddads, bought a 10-lesson bundle for $500 by card (single lessons are $60) and he's had 4. They're moving abroad next month and asked if they can get money back for the rest. The bundle terms don't mention refunds either way.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs. Haddad, congratulations on the move, and thank you for telling me early. Yes, I'll refund the six lessons Jamal hasn't used, $300, back to your card by Friday 2 October. If he'd like to keep going online after you've settled, just say and we'll find a time. Wishing you all a smooth move. Daniel
cases.note: A fair request with nothing to weigh: the yes and the exact amount go in the first lines so there's nothing to negotiate.

cases.situation: 我开了家小理发店。顾客李先生昨天剪了个168元的造型，今天发照片说两边剪得太短，要求全额退款。头发已经剪了，我觉得全退不合适，但确实比他说的要短。
cases.reply: 李先生您好，照片我看了，两侧确实比您要求的短，这是我们没沟通到位，抱歉。剪掉的没法恢复，全额退款这次就不做了，给您两个选择：退一半84元，今天原路退回；或者两周后头发长一点，店长亲自给您免费修型。您选哪个都行，告诉我就马上安排。
cases.note: 服务已经用掉时，先认下具体的问题，再给退一部分或免费补救两个选项，不争是谁的错。

cases.situation: I sell art prints on my own site. A customer bought a $60 print, said the colours looked duller than on his screen, and I offered a full refund once it's returned or a free reprint on matte paper. He's now sent three messages calling me a scammer and swearing at me.
cases.reply: I've set out what I can offer: a full $60 refund once the print is back with me, or a free reprint on matte paper. I'm going to leave it there, and both options stay open if you'd like either. I won't be replying to further messages in this tone.
cases.note: Abuse doesn't earn a better offer or a longer reply: restate the offer once, end the thread, and don't answer the insults.

cases.situation: I sell handmade ceramics online. A woman, Priya, emailed that her aunt bought her a $90 serving bowl as a birthday gift, she already has one just like it, and she wants the money refunded to her own bank account. I can only refund to the card that paid.
cases.reply: Thanks for letting me know, Priya, and happy birthday. I can't send the refund to your account, because refunds can only go back to the card your aunt paid with, but I can do one of two things: swap the bowl for anything in the shop, with a free return label, or issue a $90 store credit in your name that never expires. If your aunt would rather have the refund herself, she can reply to her order email and I'll process it as soon as the bowl is back. Which would you prefer?
cases.note: When the person asking isn't the payer, give them options that are theirs to take, and keep the refund route with the buyer.

cases.situation: I sell retro-style sneakers online, $120 a pair, with 30-day returns if unworn. A customer, Owen, sent a pair back inside the window for a full refund, but they arrived today with scuffed soles and creased toes, clearly worn outside.
cases.reply: Hi Owen, thanks for sending the sneakers back, they arrived today. They've been worn outside, with scuffed soles and creased toes, so I can't resell them and can't refund the full $120. What I can do is refund $60 today, or post them back to you at my cost so you keep them. Which would you prefer? Either way, sorry they weren't the right pair for you.
cases.note: When a return breaks the condition, describe what arrived as a fact, not an accusation, and offer two real options.

cases.situation: 我开网店卖羊绒大衣。老顾客孙小姐9月20日买了一件，899元，昨天店庆降到759元，她来问能不能退140元差价。店里没有保价的规定，衣服她已经穿过了。
cases.reply: 孙小姐您好，刚买完就碰上降价，换我也会觉得有点亏。这140元差价我给您退，今天就原路退回。店里平时没有保价，这次是谢谢您一直支持我们，以后还是按下单时的价格为准，先跟您说清楚，免得以后有误会。谢谢您一直喜欢我们家的衣服！
cases.note: 先共情，第二句就给答案；破例说明只是这一次，不变成新规矩。

cases.situation: I sell handmade soap and skincare online. A customer, Joanne, bought a $34 lavender face balm and says it gave her a red, itchy rash after two uses; she sent a photo and asked for a refund. The full ingredient list is on the jar and the listing.
cases.reply: Hi Joanne, I'm so sorry the balm gave you a rash, and thank you for sending the photo. I've refunded the full $34 to your card today, and there's no need to send the jar back; please just stop using it. If the redness spreads or doesn't settle in a couple of days, do see a pharmacist or doctor, and if you ever get swelling of the lips or face or trouble breathing, call emergency services straight away. The full ingredient list is on the jar if it helps to show them.
cases.note: A possible skin reaction: refund in full, don't ask for proof or defend the ingredients, point to medical help, and keep a note of it in case another customer reports the same.
